ABOUT DELTA SURVEY ENGINEERING

PRECISION THAT BUILDS CONFIDENCE

Delta Survey Engineering provides professional surveying and engineering services using modern surveying equipment, advanced measurement techniques, and accurate field data. We bridge the gap between physical terrain and structural engineering, delivering certified geospatial intelligence to developers, architects, infrastructure contractors, and government authorities.

Every project is executed under stringent geodetic control frameworks. By integrating robotic Total Stations with 0.5-second angular precision, multi-frequency GNSS RTK receivers, and aerial LiDAR drones, we eliminate guesswork and ensure sub-millimeter construction compliance.

01. Geodetic Control Networks

Establishment of permanent benchmarks tied to national datum coordinate systems.

02. Digital Terrain Modeling (DTM)

High-density 3D contour meshes, TIN surfaces, and earthwork volume calculation.

03. Construction Setting Out

Sub-millimeter stakeout for high-rise columns, piling caps, and infrastructure alignments.

04. Statutory Land Compliance

FMB verification, boundary demarcation, and municipal online approval drawing preparation.

EXPLORE CAPABILITIES
INSTRUMENT: LEICA TS16 ROBOTIC CALIBRATED: 2026

COMPREHENSIVE GEOSPATIAL SOLUTIONS

OUR SURVEYING & ENGINEERING SERVICES

We combine cutting-edge instrumentation with licensed surveying expertise to deliver mm-accurate deliverables for civil engineering, commercial development, and legal land records.

01 • TOPOGRAPHICAL

Topographical Survey

Detailed 3D mapping of natural and man-made terrain features, spot elevations, contours, utilities, and boundaries for architectural and civil design.

TOLERANCE: ±1.2mm
02 • CADASTRAL

Property & Cadastral Survey

Legal land boundary demarcation, survey stone planting, encroachment dispute resolution, and Field Measurement Book (FMB) verification.

LEGAL COMPLIANCE
03 • ELEVATION

Contour & Elevation Survey

High-density gradient analysis, slope contour lines (0.2m intervals), water runoff routing, and cut & fill volumetric calculations.

INTERVAL: 0.20M
04 • CONSTRUCTION

Building Setting Out

Precise transfer of structural drawings to site ground: column grids, pile foundations, shear walls, and building setbacks with sub-millimeter accuracy.

TOLERANCE: ±0.8mm
05 • GEOMETRY

Area Calculation & COGO

Rigorous closed traverse perimeter and area computation in Sq.Ft, Acres, Cents, and Hectares for land sales, deeds, and statutory registration.

100% MATHEMATICAL
06 • AERODROME

Airport & Runway Survey

High-order geodetic surveys for runway centerlines, longitudinal grades, glide paths, and Obstacle Limitation Surfaces (OLS) strictly conforming to ICAO standards.

ICAO ANNEX 14
07 • STATUTORY CAD

Online Building Approval Plans

Municipal-compliant digitized layout plans, setback verifications, FSI schedules, and master plan drawing preparation for government portal clearance.

MUNICIPAL COMPLIANT

PRECISION WORKFLOW

OUR 7-STEP SURVEY PROCESS

From initial geodetic benchmark tie-in to the final stamped engineering report, every phase is governed by strict ISO & ICAO accuracy standards.

01

Site Inspection

Physical reconnaissance of terrain, line-of-sight analysis, and recovery of existing national geodetic benchmarks.

BENCHMARK RECOVERY
02

Survey Planning

Formulation of traverse loops, satellite geometry window planning (DOP), and selection of calibrated instruments.

PDOP < 1.5 TARGET
03

Field Measurement

Total Station instrument setup, dual-axis digital leveling, and GNSS RTK base station carrier-phase initialization.

DUAL-AXIS LEVEL
04

Data Collection

High-density coordinate logging with automated feature coding for boundaries, spot heights, and physical utilities.

XYZ FEATURE CODES
05

Digital Processing

Raw vector import, Bowditch traverse balancing, triangulation TIN mesh generation, and AutoCAD drafting.

CIVIL 3D / LANDXML
06

Quality Verification

Independent mathematical closure checks, FMB deed overlap verification, and municipal standard compliance audit.

TRAVERSE CLOSURE < 1:20000
07

Final Survey Report

Issuance of certified georeferenced DWG plans, signed area certificates, LandXML surfaces, and legal dossiers.

CERTIFIED DELIVERABLE
ENTERPRISE HARDWARE & SOFTWARE

TECHNOLOGY WE USE

Our surveyors operate the gold standard in Swiss and American geomatics instrumentation, ensuring zero mechanical or digital compromise.

0.5" SEC PRECISION

Robotic Total Stations

Leica TS16 & Trimble S7 robotic total stations with automated target recognition (ATRplus) and sub-millimeter phase EDM rangefinding.

  • • Auto Target Tracking up to 1,500m
  • • Reflectorless EDM range to 1,000m
  • • Quad-surface optical angle sensors
MULTI-CONSTELLATION

GPS / GNSS RTK Systems

Trimble R12i & Leica GS18 T tilt-compensated GNSS rovers tracking GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou satellite constellations simultaneously.

  • • Calibration-free magnetic immunity tilt
  • • Centimeter RTK fix in under 4 seconds
  • • Real-time cellular CORS network tie-in
AERIAL LIDAR

Drone Survey & LiDAR

DJI Matrice 350 RTK equipped with Zenmuse L2 LiDAR scanner and full-frame photogrammetric sensor for rapid corridor and quarry mapping.

  • • 240,000 laser pulses per second
  • • Vegetation penetration capability
  • • Sub-2cm absolute vertical elevation
0.2mm LEVELING

Digital Electronic Levels

Leica LS15 electronic digital levels with invar bar code staves, providing high-precision height benchmarks for dams, high-speed rail, and runways.

  • • Standard deviation 0.2mm per 1km double-run
  • • Automated optical staff recognition
  • • Zero observer transcription errors
CAD / DWG / LANDXML

AutoCAD Civil 3D Engine

Industrial CAD drafting and surface computation workstation suite generating georeferenced DWG plans, TIN models, and volume schedules.

  • • Dynamic elevation profile cuts
  • • Full LandXML & Shapefile compatibility
  • • Municipal CMDA/DTCP colored layouts
SPATIAL ANALYTICS

GIS Spatial Analysis

Enterprise QGIS and ArcGIS Pro geospatial databases integrating satellite imagery, government village maps, cadastral boundaries, and master zoning.

  • • Multi-layer cadastral overlay analysis
  • • Watershed & flood risk elevation modeling
  • • Georeferenced WGS84 raster rectification
